reviews.review_msg: Great professor, lectures are boring and she talks a lot, but I find when I listen she explains the concepts very well. She was very clear on what would be tested on, which was really nice compared to other professors. Everything on the midterms will be found on the lecture slides #fairs. Be weary about the time, test is long

Melissa is a kind, soft spoken professor. she puts a lot of effort into her slides which are posted on canvas. her teaching is easy to understand, and is not rushed. she uses a lot of iclickers in her slides and you need to get 50% of them so attendance is semi-mandatory. the midterm and final questions are very fair and follows the slides closely
